audience: Curious general nonfiction readers who like Freakonomics-style questions, everyday economics, surprising data stories and practical ways to understand abstract systems without technical math.
author: Anton BV
citation_policy: Non-obvious factual or historical claims should trace to explicit sources; external index descriptions should retain source provenance.
description: Proposed Amazon-first BookSpec for human review. The book should read as a compact, story-led popular nonfiction title built around vivid indices, methodological caution and a curated library of unusual comparisons.

execution_cost.notes: Use cheap structured API/provider tasks for bounded enrichment and research extraction; use human/Codex only for editorial judgment and manuscript quality gates.

expected_outcome: Human decides whether this Amazon-first positioning is strong enough to approve for outline/manuscript production.
illustration_policy: No custom illustration generation yet. Prefer text-first edition with charts/screenshots only after explicit rights review.
